title: Numbers from text
description:
Read lines with `read_line` until the input ends. Each line holds one whole number, possibly with a minus sign in front. Convert the text to a number **yourself** (no `read_int`): multiply by 10 and add each digit. Then print the number, its double and its square:

For the input

```
12
-7
300
```

print

```
12 doubled is 24, squared is 144
-7 doubled is -14, squared is 49
300 doubled is 600, squared is 90000
```

A line that is not a number (empty, a letter, a lone `-`, digits followed by something else) prints `not a number: ` and the line.

starter.main.asm:
global  _start
        section .bss
line:   resb    64

        section .text
_start:
.next:
        lea     rdi, [rel line]
        mov     esi, 64
        call    read_line
        cmp     rax, -1
        je      .exit
        lea     rdi, [rel line]
        call    print_str
        call    print_newline
        jmp     .next
.exit:
        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

solution.main.asm:
global  _start
        section .bss
line:   resb    64

        section .data
s_double: db    " doubled is ", 0
s_square: db    ", squared is ", 0
s_bad:  db      "not a number: ", 0

        section .text
_start:
.next:
        lea     rdi, [rel line]
        mov     esi, 64
        call    read_line
        cmp     rax, -1
        je      .exit

        lea     rsi, [rel line]
        xor     ebx, ebx                ; the value
        xor     r12d, r12d              ; 1 when negative
        cmp     byte [rsi], '-'
        jne     .first
        mov     r12d, 1
        inc     rsi
.first: movzx   eax, byte [rsi]         ; there must be at least one digit
        sub     eax, '0'
        cmp     eax, 9
        ja      .bad
.digit: movzx   eax, byte [rsi]
        test    al, al
        jz      .parsed
        sub     eax, '0'
        cmp     eax, 9
        ja      .bad
        imul    rbx, rbx, 10
        add     rbx, rax
        inc     rsi
        jmp     .digit
.parsed:
        test    r12d, r12d
        jz      .show
        neg     rbx
.show:
        mov     rdi, rbx
        call    print_int
        lea     rdi, [rel s_double]
        call    print_str
        lea     rdi, [rbx + rbx]
        call    print_int
        lea     rdi, [rel s_square]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, rbx
        imul    rdi, rbx
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline
        jmp     .next
.bad:
        lea     rdi, [rel s_bad]
        call    print_str
        lea     rdi, [rel line]
        call    print_str
        call    print_newline
        jmp     .next
.exit:
        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall
